cases.name: empty
cases.covers: No scope grants nothing, whatever the bits say.

cases.name: wildcard
cases.covers: Short-circuits every check before expansion, including collab.

cases.name: pdf-permissions
cases.covers: The whole bit expansion table, one row per permission word.

cases.name: annotate-modify-implies-read
cases.covers: You cannot sensibly modify what you cannot see.

cases.name: forms-modify-implies-fill-and-read
cases.covers: The two-step implication, which a Rust port could easily do in one.

cases.name: forms-fill-implies-read
cases.covers: The second step on its own.

cases.name: collab-implies-annotate-read
cases.covers: A mutation route has to see the row to evaluate the filter against it.

cases.name: forms-submit-is-grant-only
cases.covers: No bit expands to it, so even all-bits plus pdf.permissions withholds it.

cases.name: narrowing-modify-plus-update-self
cases.covers: The case the narrowing model exists for: [modify, update:self] means edit own only, not edit anyone via modify-bypass.

cases.name: narrowing-is-per-action
cases.covers: update is narrowed, delete still falls back to the broad modify default.

cases.name: narrowing-from-bits-not-scope
cases.covers: The broad default can arrive through pdf.permissions, and narrowing still shadows it.

cases.name: group-filter-needs-membership
cases.covers: Named for the rule before 4b2cdb395. group=X now matches a target in group X whether or not the caller belongs to X: membership is no longer part of the filter.

cases.name: group-filter-with-membership
cases.covers: The same scope for a caller who is in the group.

cases.name: self-filter-without-identity
cases.covers: No user_id means :self matches nothing, rather than matching a row with no owner.

cases.name: action-wildcard-covers-every-action
cases.covers: annotations:*:all narrows every action at once.

cases.name: set-group-default-needs-no-authority
cases.covers: Assigning your own default group is not a reassignment.

cases.name: set-group-is-not-implied-by-modify
cases.covers: Assignment authority is cloud-only and does not inherit from modify.

cases.name: set-group-all
cases.covers: Authority over any destination group.

cases.name: set-group-one-group
cases.covers: Authority over one destination group and not another.

cases.name: set-group-through-action-wildcard
cases.covers: The action wildcard reaches set-group.

cases.name: set-group-ignores-unusable-filters-on-wildcard
cases.covers: An action wildcard carrying :self is legitimate for other actions and cannot satisfy set-group.

cases.name: duplicate-scopes
cases.covers: Repeats are a set, not a multiset.

cases.name: order-does-not-matter
cases.covers: The same grants written the other way round.
